clusters.detailedNarrative:
# St Johann / Novartis Campus — Basel-Stadt

St. Johann is an active headquarters and biomedical-research campus, with external-company offices, an innovation-park coworking operation and the occupied Friedrich Miescher Institute for Biomedical Research building. The actionable property lead is the existing Building 210 office offer, not a verified new laboratory development or quantified vacancy. No source reviewed establishes a St. Johann closure, released building, sublease or new-building delivery during 2025/2026. Novartis’s Swiss manufacturing reconfiguration announcement concerns Schweizerhalle and Stein; its Basel dateline is not a St. Johann property event. [SJ01] [SJ02] [SJ04] [SJ11] [SJ18]

**Canton BS; municipality Basel. Research cutoff 4 November 2026.** The cluster retains aerial ID `basel-st-johann-novartis-campus`, Novartis company ID `gco_9328b082a7756ed365fb` and site ID `basel:site:novartis-basel`. The full address, building, resident-reference and figure schedules are in the accompanying [St. Johann JSON record]([retained internal document] This is every verified address identified in the reviewed material, not an exhaustive tenancy census; no public coverage denominator is established.

## Occupier inventory

Novartis’s current directory attributes **Fabrikstrasse 2, Novartis Campus, CH-4056 Basel** to Novartis Pharma AG / Biomedical Research. The campus operator independently uses it as the general campus arrival address. It therefore supports research presence and campus orientation, but does not establish a particular Novartis AG legal-entity suite or the laboratories behind the gate. The group’s documented functions are global headquarters, international commercial headquarters and R&D, with operations and global support functions also identified in the company’s Swiss site profile. [SJ02] [SJ16] [SJ17]

The directory also verifies separate addresses that must not be collapsed into Fabrikstrasse 2. Novartis International AG and Novartis Pharma AG’s Pharmaceuticals entry are at **Forum 1, Novartis Campus, CH-4056 Basel**. Novartis Holding AG is **c/o Novartis International AG at Forum 1**: this is a corporate address, not evidence of a separately occupied tenancy. Novartis Pharma Services AG is at **Lichtstrasse 35, CH-4056 Basel**. These entities are retained under the existing Novartis group ID; no new global company master is created. Their individual office areas, floors, employee counts, tenure and commercial terms remain unknown. [SJ02]

Ultragenyx’s current company directory identifies its **EMEA headquarters at WSJ 210/11, Lichtstrasse 35, Postfach 3775, 4002 Basel**. The building/location code is preserved exactly, not translated into an invented suite. This is an office/HQ function; the same directory separately labels its US gene-therapy research and manufacturing sites. No Swiss wet-laboratory or manufacturing capability should be assigned from that global company activity. The existing Ultragenyx profile ID is `gco_ab05462572077b994707`; no existing Basel site ID was found in V6. [SJ10]

SOTIO Biotech AG’s Swiss contact page gives **Lichtstrasse 35 – WSJ-210, 4056 Basel** and provides business-development and clinical-department contacts. It does not identify an occupied floor, wet laboratory or manufacturing operation. FoRx Therapeutics AG gives **Lichtstrasse 35, 4056 Basel** as its current company contact address. FoRx’s address and the operator’s campus reference support a campus-associated company contact, but not a separately measured office or laboratory. Neither company has a matched V6 profile in the reviewed snapshot; both remain sourced additional canton-inventory records. Local staff, tenure, rents and lease expiries are gaps, not zero. [SJ08] [SJ09] [SJ06]

Switzerland Innovation Park Basel Area AG operates the campus’s furnished private offices and fixed-desk coworking. Its site address is **Lichtstrasse 35, 4002 Basel**, distinct from its Allschwil headquarters. The operator explicitly offers domiciliation, which is important when interpreting residents’ company addresses. A postal address here can represent a fixed desk, private office or domicile rather than a standalone suite. The dated operator article reported opening the **15th coworking floor on 24 July 2024** and moving the DayOne accelerator team there. This is a source-backed historical floor action, not a 2025/2026 expansion announcement. Current floors and their area need reconfirmation. [SJ06] [SJ07]

ISS Facility Services AG is identified in the public campus brochure as responsible for real-estate and facility-management services. That makes ISS the appropriate management contact for floor schedules and an offer, but does not establish ISS as owner or landlord. A separate ISS onsite street address, legal leasing authority and mandate period are not disclosed. [SJ05] (p. 11)

## Campus and building schedule

The Annual Report 2025 discloses **481,448 m² for “Basel, Switzerland – St. Johann”** under the heading **“Size of site, in square meters.”** Scope is the Novartis-reported St. Johann major facility; period is the 2025 year-end filing baseline, published 3 February 2026 and observed 4 November 2026. This is a primary filing-reported figure. The table does not define it as land area, gross floor area, net area or leasable space. It is not a tenant-area estimate, campus vacancy or a figure to allocate among Novartis and third-party companies. The filing’s general statement that facilities are owned or held under long-term leases does not disclose St. Johann’s specific tenure or legal title. [SJ01] (PDF p. 44 / printed p. 40)

Novartis’s official *Novartis in Switzerland 2025* profile reports **approximately 7,000 employees at Novartis Campus Basel**, with the sites section expressly dated **31 December 2025**. This is an approximate company-reported campus headcount, not all external campus residents, all Basel life-science employment or a 2026 employee count. The PDF was modified 5 May 2026; that metadata is not a new headcount date. Do not derive occupied area from the employee figure. [SJ16] (printed pp. 8 and 11)

FMI’s current operating address is **Fabrikstrasse 24, 4056 Basel**. Its contact page explicitly places the institute on Novartis Campus and distinguishes public lounge access from registration required to go beyond the lounge. The present platform page also documents the institute’s move to the campus in 2024. This is current institution occupation supported independently of the older property brochure. Its full building area, institute occupied area, owner and tenure are not disclosed in the reviewed pages. [SJ11] [SJ12]

The **Applied Tissue Models Center** is a shared FMI–Novartis platform physically split between **Fabrikstrasse 22 for Novartis and Fabrikstrasse 24 for FMI**. Its current institutional page reports **around 200 m² of laboratory space across both addresses**, explicitly at **Biosafety Levels 1 and 2**. Publication date is unknown; the page includes October 2026 activity and was observed 4 November 2026. The figure is approximate, primary institution-reported combined platform space: no allocation by building or occupier is provided. Documented functions include organoid model development, miniaturization and automated chemical/CRISPR screening, with liquid handling and optical readout equipment. These capabilities are platform-specific; they do not establish commercial GMP manufacturing or rentable campus laboratories. [SJ12]

The supplied Basel Hub brochure labels an FMI facility with **8,000 m² laboratory area and completion in 2024**. Its only documentary date is PDF metadata of **31 October 2025**, and it supplies no street-address crosswalk or defined measurement convention. The JSON therefore retains this as a historical unaddressed facility claim, not Fabrikstrasse 24’s current tenant area. The current institute address does not independently validate that total. No supplied original brochure is included in the output. [SJ20] (original p. 23)

The official campus map remains linked from the current arrival page, but is itself marked **E 11-2022**. Its addressed stock is retained in the underlying building schedule without promoting architectural “occupation” dates into current tenant evidence. In addition to the current direct-source addresses above, the map labels the following:

- **Forum 3** and **Fabrikstrasse 4, 6, 10, 12, 14, 15, 16, 18 and 28**. Fabrikstrasse 15 is the Gehry building in the map; current floor occupation and scientific functions are not verified here.
- **Square 3, Physic Garden 3, Virchow 6, Virchow 16 and Asklepios 8**. These are operator-labelled internal campus addresses. They are not silently converted into municipal streets or exact geographic points.
- **Fabrikstrasse 22**, independently supported by current laboratory-platform evidence, and the **Fabrikstrasse 2 main gate**. The map’s Novartis Pavillon label is separately resolved by the current operator to **St. Johanns-Hafen-Weg 5, 4056 Basel**. The Pavillon is an exhibition, meeting and event venue, not a laboratory tenant. [SJ15] [SJ12] [SJ17] [SJ19]

Each addressed building is preserved separately in JSON. Building gross/net area, current occupants and available floors remain unknown unless the direct evidence above says otherwise. The map is not a complete current building inventory or a source of lease boundaries.

## Availability evidence

Building 210 is currently marketed by the campus operator for offices and meeting rooms. Its live page gives **17 floors, 720 m² average floor size and 2.8 m average storey height**. Publication date is unknown; these are primary operator-reported facts observed on **4 November 2026**, not an occupied-floor count or vacancy measure. The company addresses using WSJ-210 support the Lichtstrasse 35 association, but the building/code/cadastral crosswalk still needs operator confirmation. Do not multiply the floor count by average floor size to construct a total building area. [SJ04] [SJ09] [SJ10]

The currently linked public brochure gives an **example floor plate of approximately 723 m²** and an **example subdivision of approximately 360 m²**, with the latter described as “max floor sub-division.” These are example-layout specifications, not available suite sizes. Its PDF was created in September 2021 and modified **7 April 2026**; the filename’s 2026 designation is not proof that all specifications were newly surveyed. The webpage average and brochure example are different bases and are kept separate. [SJ05] (pp. 9–10)

The brochure describes ready-to-use office fit-out supplied **as is**, with adaptations at the tenant’s cost; Ethernet/fiber infrastructure, badge-controlled separation and air ventilation are described. The live page identifies included maintenance, cleaning, security, post, waste and visitor parking, with optional services. None of this establishes laboratory ventilation capacity, electrical redundancy, containment approvals or GMP readiness. The floor-load label in the brochure is not adopted as engineering capacity because its area denominator is absent. No dated vacant-floor list, building rent, actual offered suite or handover date is disclosed. [SJ04] [SJ05]

SIP’s current live page advertises private offices **starting from CHF 1,400/month** and fixed-desk coworking **starting from CHF 360/month**. Scope is the Novartis Campus workspace offer; publication date is unknown and observation is **4 November 2026**. These are current advertised starting prices, not signed lease rents. Office size, VAT and cost inclusions, deposits and available inventory are not stated on the page. They must not be converted into CHF/m²/year or compared directly with laboratory rents. Monthly-contract wording is documented in the **July 2024 article**, not verified as a 2026 contract term. The live page’s linked older PDFs do not establish today’s free units. [SJ06] [SJ07]

## Development pipeline

The supplied JLL Basel Hub extract says **“To come: Breakthrough Properties @ Novartis Campus”** on original page 24. It gives no street address, area, lease/ownership structure or delivery date; its date is the **31 October 2025 PDF metadata**, not an explicit publication date. The reviewed current Breakthrough portfolio does not identify a Basel/Novartis project. That establishes the unresolved evidence gap, not cancellation. The record remains a historical development lead and is not counted as active construction, delivered stock or available space. [SJ20] [SJ14]

The verified 2025/2026 read is therefore continuing operations and current office marketing, with no source-backed net take-up, giveback or new-building delivery quantified. The FMI move and coworking floor opening are earlier events. Acquisitions, clinical progress and company financing are not used as closure, expansion or released-space evidence. [SJ01] [SJ07] [SJ12]

## Resident references and location conflicts

The full JSON preserves every resident link encountered on SIP’s current Novartis Campus page, including Certara, Parexel, BioFi, Bottneuro, CSEM, Jura Bio, Macrogen, Scailyte and others. This is operator-residency evidence only. Some names are provisional renderings of link slugs; not all are necessarily life-science companies. No unverified company receives Lichtstrasse 35 by inference, and no address here is treated as a suite without proof. The existing Certara and Parexel profile IDs are retained where matched. Pharmaplan and CSL Behring are separate historical campus references from the 2024 article, without a verified current street address in this pass. [SJ06] [SJ07]

IOB must not be counted as a verified St. Johann occupier from the operator FAQ. The institute’s own current contact page gives **Klybeckstrasse 141, CH-4057 Basel** for visiting and delivery, and **Mittlere Strasse 91, CH-4031 Basel** as its legal seat **for official correspondence only**. These are outside the assigned campus occupancy inventory. They should be handed to the appropriate Basel cluster researchers, with the legal seat kept distinct from physical research occupation. No second St. Johann site was established. [SJ13] [SJ06]

The official Swiss company profile separately documents Basel Drug Substance Supply as a biotechnology manufacturing operation producing, testing and releasing mammalian-cell drug substances and cell banks. It does not give an operating street address or tie the facility to this St. Johann envelope. That manufacturing reference stays unlocated here. Schweizerhalle in BL, Stein in AG and French Huningue remain separate from this campus. [SJ16] [SJ18]

## Property due diligence

The next steps are specific evidence requests, not assumptions about market demand:

1. **Obtain a dated Building 210 floor schedule from Novartis/ISS.** Require current occupiers, vacant/committed floors, actual offered units, measurement basis, office sizes, condition and move-in dates. Request a commercial offer with service inclusions and tenant-work obligations.
2. **Establish legal property interests.** Obtain parcel numbers and land-register/title extracts, building rights, encumbrances and the owner’s authority for ISS to lease. Campus branding and Novartis affiliation are not legal-owner evidence.
3. **Verify physical occupation by company.** Resolve Ultragenyx’s WSJ 210/11 designation, SOTIO’s onsite Swiss functions and occupied floor, FoRx’s office versus domicile and any separate lab, and the Novartis entities’ actual departmental allocation. Tenant areas, local employees, tenure, rent and expiry require tenancy documents or company confirmation.
4. **Check engineering and areas before underwriting laboratory use.** Obtain measured GFA/NLA/leasable schedules and the filing’s site-size definition. For Building 210 require current as-builts, clear-height definition, power/ventilation/load data, fire strategy and any lab-conversion permission. For FMI/ATMC obtain the area split, containment approvals and operating/servicing responsibilities.
5. **Resolve the development lead before putting it into a pipeline.** Ask Novartis/Breakthrough for scheme existence, address/parcels, sponsor and legal agreement, permit reference, approved area, funding, construction phase and delivery/availability timetable. Stop at “unverified” until these exist.
6. **Obtain an operator occupancy denominator.** Request residents by actual office/fixed desk versus domicile and current floor, then verify their company addresses. Resolve IOB’s contradictory operator reference and BDSS’s actual operating address separately.
7. **Match official building-register addresses before street-level pins.** Internal campus addresses, postal codes and company location codes need a cadastral crosswalk; no tenant or lease polygon is inferred from the existing image.

## Submarket aerials

The retained aerial is **SWISSIMAGE / swisstopo**, retrieved **2 November 2026**; acquisition date is not exposed and the image is not live. Its frame is an analyst-selected campus/approach envelope, not a parcel or lease boundary. Existing campus and Pavillon markers are orientation points, not company suites. The newly verified addresses in this report have not been silently pinned or added to the application. [The retained aerial exhibit]([retained internal document] is suitable for orientation with these precision labels, not evidence of present vacancy. Source: [SWISSIMAGE product information](https://www.swisstopo.admin.ch/en/orthoimage-swissimage-10); attribution **© swisstopo**.

Publication dates are unknown unless stated below; PDF metadata and observation dates are not automatically publication or occupancy dates. The supplied JLL extracts and V6 record were reviewed before current verification. Existing figures ledgers contained no matching locked campus metrics. This V1 creates only the named research files and does not change the application, shared snapshot or company master.

clusters.detailedNarrative:
# Klybeck / Stücki northern research corridor — Basel-Stadt

Stücki is an established operating cluster for drug-product development, antibody-drug conjugate research, medtech production and serviced laboratories. Klybeck combines current biotech offices and institutional research with existing offices, laboratory refurbishment and a longer-term redevelopment pipeline. The important underwriting distinction is **operating occupancy versus a marketed property programme**: current company addresses do not measure demised space, and provider/campus area figures do not establish vacancy or tenant demand. All observations below are as of **4 November 2026**; undated pages establish what is currently published, not a contemporaneous physical inspection. [KS01] [KS05] [KS06] [KS07] [KS08] [KS11]

The assigned geography is the northern corridor within the municipality of Basel, canton **BS**. Swiss Life's Campus Klybeck, Rhystadt's Neues Klybeck and Stücki Park are separate property contexts. Novartis Campus, Rosental/Roche, Allschwil and Fricktal are not imported into this inventory through proximity or brochure logos. No acquisition has been used to infer a closure.

## Occupier inventory

**Lonza Drug Product Services** publishes **Hochbergerstrasse 60 A, G, 4057 Basel** as its Stücki location. Its actual functions include parenteral formulation, analytical development and quality control, drug-product process development, testing and related manufacturing expertise. The page describes GMP quality systems; it does not establish the installed commercial aseptic capacity disclosed for Lonza's separate Stein site. Its **13,000 m² “Facility”** callout is an undated, company-reported facility measure across a grouped address, with no net/gross/lease basis or A/G allocation. It is not a measured 2026 lease demise. Retain company ID `gco_59823ff9aac271b5cc32` and site ID `basel:site:lonza-stuecki`. [KS01]

The supplied JLL/Basel Area brochure, dated **31 October 2025 by PDF metadata**, states that Lonza occupied two fully occupied Stücki buildings, **each 8,000 sqm** on page 29. That statement stays historical; the buildings are not summed into a current leased or campus aggregate. A separate primary landlord release dated **28 March 2019** described a planned additional **8,000 m²** rental in building 60G from the third quarter of 2020. These figures have different periods and bases. Neither reconciles the current facility callout or proves the origin of today's advertised space at 60A. [KS25]

**NBE-Therapeutics AG**, a Boehringer Ingelheim subsidiary, has a current company-supported address at **Hochbergerstrasse 60I, 4057 Basel**. The parent announced the completed Basel ADC R&D centre opening on **3 April 2025**. The opening's **1,826 m² of laboratories and offices** is a historical facility description, not a classified net/gross area or refreshed 2026 suite measurement. The company's contact footer and dated privacy statement support the fuller street spelling; the main contact block shortens it. Retain `gco_7a1b3460a09f20347048` / `basel:site:nbe-basel`. This is continuing Basel presence after acquisition, not an Allschwil relocation or closure. [KS02] [KS03] [KS04]

**BioVersys AG** publishes **c/o Technologiepark, Hochbergerstrasse 60c, 4057 Basel**. The existing V6 record retains headquarters and R&D; the current Tech Park directory describes antibacterial resistance research and labels the location **C3**. Preserve that operator label without decoding it into a legal suite or floor. Retain `gco_98c2776a061ff24fea05` / `basel:site:bioversys-basel`. **Medartis AG** publishes **Hochbergerstrasse 60E, 4057 Basel** for its Basel headquarters; its Basel-specific page also identifies implant-production and trovalisation imagery. That supports production-related activity, but not a quantified production plant, certified cleanroom or throughput. Retain the Medartis Holding profile `gco_b60cc392c4a72102e451` / `basel:site:medartis-basel`, with Medartis AG as the local operator. [KS05] [KS06] [KS20]

**LifeMine Therapeutics (Switzerland) GmbH** publishes **Klybeckstrasse 191, WKL-136/6. OG, 4057 Basel**. Its contact page calls Basel an additional office in the global network. Do not promote that address to a locally quantified wet-lab or manufacturing operation. Retain `gco_fb97894921c0acd2fc4b` / `basel:site:lifemine-basel`. **Monte Rosa Therapeutics AG** independently publishes **WKL-136.3, Klybeckstrasse 191, 4057 Basel**. The current contact establishes a Swiss company location, not an exact occupied area or expiry. The existing imported Monte Rosa parent profile ID `claude_csv:5c6eedfb4fa8:675` is retained as the matching parent reference; its Boston site ID is not reused for Basel. The Swiss legal-entity link needs register confirmation. [KS07] [KS08]

The historical brochure's page-28 reference to an unnamed Rhystadt building “occupied until 2027,” with Monte Rosa as an example, is not a company-specific lease-expiry disclosure. The current Tech Park homepage calls Monte Rosa an **alumnus** in its testimonial, so that testimonial is not current Stücki residency proof. [KS18]

**Superlab Suisse Basel AG** publishes **Hochbergerstr. 60 I, 4057 Basel**. The provider is an operating lab-as-a-service platform, not one biotech occupier. Swiss Prime Site's dated completed-project account confirms its service at Stücki since mid-2024. The provider's current **4,770 m² lab-and-office** callout is an undated programme footprint, not available laboratory space or the area of its members. The campus advertises BSL1/2 serviced laboratories; current licences, particular module availability and technical certificates remain request items. [KS09] [KS10] [KS11]

**Walter Klybeck** has an operating coworking/event address at **Klybeckstrasse 161, 4057 Basel, K-25**. The campus says offices have been in use since **March 2025**. Its distinct laboratory offer is in **K-410 at Klybeckstrasse 206**. The dated campus article still described that refurbishment as underway on **17 September 2026**, while the undated provider page advertises immediately usable laboratories. The correct status is **readiness unresolved**, not simply delivered or planned. Advertised **6–45 m²** plug-and-play typologies and starting charges of **CHF 1,200/month** for laboratories and **CHF 380/month** for coworking are provider service offers observed on the cutoff date, not conventional effective rents per square metre or verified available suites. [KS12] [KS13] [KS14]

The full JSON also retains **Alira Health at Hochbergerstrasse 60F** as a company-supported office address and **Tech Park Basel at Hochbergerstrasse 60C** as an infrastructure-provider address. The latter's undated **6,700 m² “Rental Area”** is the operator programme, not a vacant-space figure or a 60C-only building total. Its advertised minimum office and equipped-lab typologies are **12 m²** and **43 m²**, respectively; admission and availability require its application process. [KS16] [KS17] [KS18] [KS19]

## Institutions and operator residency

**IOB, the Institute of Molecular and Clinical Ophthalmology Basel**, is source-backed institutional research in Campus Klybeck. The institute's current **visiting and delivery address is Klybeckstrasse 141, 4057 Basel**; **Mittlere Strasse 91** is explicitly its legal-correspondence address, not this corridor's operating entrance. The campus identifies IOB with **K-420**, but the research-building code has not been reconciled to the institute's visiting address or demised labs. Do not pin a K-420 laboratory roof at 141 by assumption. [KS21] [KS22]

Swiss Life is a Klybeck landowner, while **Swiss Life Asset Management AG** is the campus contact at K-141. Rhystadt is the other landowner and the FLOW project operator, with a published contact in **WKL-136.EG, Klybeckstrasse 191**. For Stücki, primary Swiss Prime Site project material provides development/landlord evidence, and the live campus contact identifies **Wincasa AG** as centre and mixed-use site management, with **Equans** for technical facility management. None substitutes for parcel-specific title or an executed tenant lease. [KS14] [KS23] [KS24] [KS25] [KS26]

The JSON preserves the current Tech Park community directory separately, including biotech, medtech and discovery-engine residency labels. Those entries are not assigned the operator's 60C postal address. This distinction is material: the directory labels NBE **B2**, whereas NBE's current company/legal evidence supports **60I**. Possible stale or additional residency remains unresolved. The separate Stücki directory also lists TargImmune, but TargImmune's current company contact is **St. Alban-Anlage 70, 4052 Basel**, outside this northern corridor. It is therefore a conflicting/out-of-area lead, not a current verified Stücki company address. [KS20] [KS33] [KS34]

## Campus and building schedule

The **17 September 2026** Campus Klybeck schedule lists **K-25: 4,300 m²** office/storage/commercial, **K-141: 8,048 m²** office/coworking/commercial and **K-410: 3,100 m²** laboratory/office. These are the campus's **“Total area” rental-programme figures**; no gross/net building definition or current vacant quantum is supplied. Named operating office users do not establish complete building occupancy. K-25's Apleona move is announced **from November 2026**, not confirmed completed on 4 November. K-141 is an office programme, not a blanket life-science laboratory allocation. [KS14] [KS15]

Rhystadt's current building schedule is more specific. **WKL-136** is marketed at **Klybeckstrasse 191** for immediate fitted office/lab occupation. Its first/second-floor headline is **approximately 2,600 m²**, while the detailed listings are **1,590 m² office/laboratory on the first floor** and **173 m² and 696 m² offices on the second**. The detailed rows total **2,459 m²**, not the rounded headline. Asking rent is **CHF 220/m²/year or on request**; exclusions, VAT, incentives and service charges are unknown. The marketed **3.2-metre ceiling height** and support/handling facilities are source specifications, not independently measured clear height or lab licensing. None of these available floors measures LifeMine or Monte Rosa's occupancy elsewhere in WKL-136. [KS27]

**WKL-132** uses the same marketed campus address and offers **4,168 m² rental space**, comprising **1,042 m² on each of the third through sixth floors**, at **CHF 200/m²/year asking rent**. It is fitted office space, not verified wet-lab stock. **WKL-121** markets **1,140 m²** of office/commercial space at **CHF 95/m²/year or on request**, with a stated fixed-term offer **until March 2028**. Its listed floor rows total **1,139 m²**. The offered term is not a current life-science company's lease expiry. Both addresses require an actual building/entrance crosswalk before plotting, because the property pages publish a common campus address. [KS28] [KS29]

For Stücki, Swiss Prime Site's **17 December 2024** account describes **Stücki Park II as completed**, with **28,000 m² usable floor space** for laboratory and office uses. That is a defined extension-project measure, not whole-campus stock, current leased area or available inventory. Separate property records retain verified **60A, 60C, 60E, 60F, 60G and 60I** addresses, plus the current operator's **60B, Hochbergerstrasse 70 and Badenstrasse 3** offer titles. No aggregate tenant area is allocated between them. [KS11] [KS32]

## Development pipeline and availability evidence

**FLOW** is Rhystadt's refurbishment and extension of an existing lab/office building, with a current **approximately 19,000 m² future laboratory-and-office programme**. The primary German project timeline expects **construction start in 2027** and **occupation in Q3 2029**. Its captions refer to **Klybeck 125**, but a verified street address and unique entrance were not established. Future-phase prose in the English version says “construction underway” and “ready”; it should not be misread as a present completed status. Planned up-to-BSL-2 research uses, utility provision to tenancy boundaries and a **LEED Gold target** are advertised project specifications, not operating licences or achieved certification. The dated **26 October 2026** Rhystadt article supports reuse/extension, not completion. [KS30] [KS31]

The supplied October 2025 brochure separately recorded an unnamed **19,000 sqm Rhystadt project opening mid-2028**. The current FLOW offer is the relevant live pipeline lead, but the brochure-to-building identity has not been proven. Retain both evidentiary records; do not silently assert a confirmed schedule delay for the identical asset.

The canton describes the wider klybeckplus project as **nearly 30 hectares of transformation land**, in its **26 November 2025** planning release, with Swiss Life and Rhystadt as landowners. That is land area, not lettable floorspace. The Richtprojekt is a basis for land-use planning; the canton expected the development plan and public consultation in **early 2027**. The supplied Campus Klybeck brochure's **885,000 m²** district figure, page 7, has **no defined area basis** and is not converted into inventory or land. Planned residents/jobs are not used as current workforce. [KS23]

The live Stücki operator inventory advertises a **901 m², level-7 laboratory at Hochbergerstrasse 60A**, described as **BSL2, fully fitted**, with occupation **by agreement**. It also lists a **3,000 m² second-floor HO70 offer**, labelled extended basic fit-out and associated with Lab Seventy imagery. The historical brochure's **10,000 m² Lab Seventy office/lab offer from 2026** remains a historical whole-programme claim, not verified current delivered lab space. The present floor offer cannot establish the larger programme's delivery. [KS32]

Stücki's online data need reconciliation before use in an underwriting schedule: the **HO60B level-1 row says 399 m²**, but the detail says **60A / 256 m²**; the level-4 row says **415 m²**, while its office detail says **413 m²**. Office whole-floor and partial-floor cards in 60F may overlap. Rent cells such as “CHF 590” have no visible denominator/period in the extracted table, so they are not converted to CHF/m²/year. The JSON retains encountered office-module and building offers, but no additive market vacancy, rent average or absorption measure. [KS32]

## Property due diligence

The immediate gating items are K-410 commissioning and permitted-use evidence; a current WKL-136 unit schedule that reconciles headline and floor rows; and corrected Stücki unit/area/rent-denominator data. Obtain source-occupier and lease-demise evidence before attributing any listed space to a giveback. Lonza needs a dated A/G lease plan and rent roll to reconcile the current facility callout and historical building statements. NBE and Superlab need separate 60I floor boundaries, rather than summed facility figures.

FLOW requires the permit decision, start-of-works proof, building/parcel/address crosswalk and dated delivery programme. IOB requires its K-420 research entrance/lease crosswalk. Lab Seventy requires a current whole-project programme, technical standard and completion/available-unit schedule. Request parcel-specific title, contaminated-site and building-remediation reports, and intended-use restrictions. The canton explicitly identifies contamination-related removal of some buildings in the wider plan; that does not certify the suitability of any retained laboratory. [KS23]

For each occupier, company-occupied area, local workforce, legal contracting entity, leased versus owned interest, suite/floor, effective rent, expiry/options, floor loading, clear heights, ventilation, power/redundancy and manufacturing capacity remain unknown unless separately stated above. Source-labelled marketed specifications are not inspected capabilities. The operator directories support further address diligence, not an exhaustive verified company universe.

## Submarket aerials

Retain `basel-klybeck-stucki-klybeck`, `basel-klybeck-stucki-stuecki` and `basel-supplemental-bioversys-basel`. Existing aerials were retrieved **2 November 2026**, but their acquisition dates are not exposed; they are not live images. The existing Klybeck unit contains LifeMine and K-25 orientation references. The retained Stücki frame is **context-only with no company rows** and its southern edge is north of the V6 resolved 60-series company address points. It needs southward reframing and point QA before it can serve as street-level occupier coverage in the app or print set.

No new street pins were invented here. Shared campus addresses at 191 and 141, Lonza's grouped A/G address and FLOW's unverified street address must not be plotted as multiple precise roofs. The parent integration team should use the existing source-address records and new verified references, preserve IDs, and disclose the aerial-vintage gap. The shared application, masters and aerial files were not modified by this research.

## Source and coverage notes
Public primary pages were observed on 4 November 2026 unless marked as supplied recent evidence. NBE's same-day verified primary findings are reused from the supplied V6 correction. Historical internal sources are cited by title, date and page above; **no original brochure, private file or brochure image is included in this output**. The full JSON contains source visibility, quantity scope, publication/as-of, area basis, statuses and the complete encountered inventory.

clusters.detailedNarrative:
# Basel SBB / Aeschen / Downtown headquarters district — BS

Basel’s SBB–Peter Merian–Aeschen corridor is an operating headquarters and regional-office district. The verified functions include global corporate administration, therapeutic-area management, commercial operations, clinical-development management, licensing and life-science investment. The reviewed evidence does **not** establish a common wet-laboratory campus, a downtown manufacturing plant or laboratory vacancy. It does establish a material headquarters redevelopment at Lonza’s Lindenhofareal and specific owner-advertised office offers at Grosspeter Tower. Those are different property situations and should not be combined into a life-science vacancy total. [SD01] [SD02] [SD11] [SD12] [SD13] [SD17]

The geographic scope is the municipality of Basel in Basel-Stadt, including the retained SBB/Peter Merian corridor, Aeschenplatz/Aeschengraben and the southern historic centre. Allschwil, other Basel-Landschaft municipalities, Stücki/Klybeck, Roche/Rosental, Novartis and the research campus remain separate. The accompanying JSON preserves the full address inventory identified in the reviewed sources, including additional local operators and distinct legal-entity contacts. It is not an exhaustive district census: no coverage denominator has been established.

Research cutoff and observation date are **4 November 2026**. Undated live webpages are recorded as publication-unknown, not assigned a publication date from their copyright footers. Source-linked figure metadata in the JSON distinguishes land area, historic BGF, current gross building program, rentable property area and advertised office area. No company occupied-area total or local workforce figure has been inferred.

## Occupier inventory

### SBB and Peter Merian headquarters

**Lonza’s global headquarters remains the Lonza Tower at Muenchensteinerstrasse 38, 4002 Basel.** Its current company page expressly identifies the tower as global headquarters. The local operator/landowner named in the official planning evidence is Lonza AG; the retained company profile is Lonza Group AG, `gco_59823ff9aac271b5cc32`, with site `basel:site:lonza-basel`. The downtown function is headquarters, not the separate drug-product laboratory site at Stücki or manufacturing at Stein. A temporary relocation is planned for the tower renovation, but no current departure, permanent closure or present-day vacancy is established. [SD01] [SD12] [SD13] [SD15]

**Sandoz AG’s operating global headquarters is at Elsässertor, Centralbahnstrasse 4, 4051 Basel.** The company inaugurated the headquarters on 7 November 2024, and its live global contact page still gives this address. This resolves the distinction between the earlier proposed move and an actual headquarters. The existing V6 profile is Sandoz Group AG, `gco_b8f864b04cb9be33f50f`, site `basel:site:sandoz-basel`; the company-published local contact is Sandoz AG. Neither source gives a tenant demise, leased area or manufacturing/laboratory specification. No subsequent physical increase, contraction or lease expiry in 2025/2026 is established. [SD08] [SD09]

**Bayer’s strategic centre is at Peter Merian-Strasse 84, CH-4002 Basel.** Bayer identifies the international Consumer Health headquarters, the Pharmaceuticals therapeutic-area hub and the Crop Science EMEA headquarters in Basel. Its central functions include finance, HR, procurement, legal/compliance, IT and communications. Pharmaceuticals activities cover oncology, ophthalmology, hematology and parts of Women’s Healthcare. These are current Basel-site functions, not evidence of laboratories or manufacturing in this office property. [SD02]

The same primary page separately lists **Bayer Consumer Care AG**, **Bayer CropScience Schweiz AG** and **Bayer (Schweiz) AG / Vertrieb Crop Science** at that street address. All are preserved in the JSON; they must not be counted as separate buildings or assigned duplicate property area. The retained match is `gco_062ab0b46b981ac873e1`, site `basel:site:bayer-basel`, for Bayer Consumer Care AG. The additional legal-entity contacts have null master/site IDs rather than invented matches. The page does not allocate floors, NLA or contracts between the entities. [SD02]

**Institut Straumann AG’s international headquarters is at Peter Merian-Weg 12, 4002 Basel.** The group contact page identifies this as the global headquarters contact, which should be distinguished from the retained holding-company profile, Straumann Holding AG, `gco_9946366562f4f323ac70`, site `basel:site:straumann-basel`. The main entrance is accessible to trams and pedestrians. Straumann expressly directs cars and trucks to **Lindenhofstrasse 46**; that is an alternate access address, not an additional occupied site or area. Local laboratory, training and production allocations remain unverified. [SD03]

**Moderna Switzerland GmbH’s EMEA and Swiss headquarters is at Peter Merian Weg 10, 4052 Basel.** The current Swiss company contact page explicitly labels these headquarters functions. The retained company/site IDs are `gco_689b0fee6bd476898115` and `basel:site:moderna-basel`; parent Moderna Inc. is kept separate. The source does not disclose floors, leased NLA, local staffing or mRNA manufacturing at this address. Adjacency to Straumann is not evidence of a common campus, lease or ownership structure. [SD04]

### Aeschen and southern downtown offices

**BeOne Medicines publishes its Swiss office at Aeschengraben 27, 21st Floor, 4051 Basel.** The floor is an explicit company-published contact detail, observed on 4 November 2026; it is not a full-floor exclusive tenancy or leased-area figure. Retained IDs are `gco_a5f6ee42b57823facfc9` and `basel:site:beone-basel`. Current physical office evidence is the locations page, not the corporate redomiciliation alone. The local tenant entity, area and precise operating functions require confirmation. [SD05]

**Sumitomo Pharma Switzerland GmbH independently publishes an office at Aeschengraben 27, 4051 Basel.** Its Swiss website identifies parent Sumitomo Pharma Co., Ltd. and describes the consolidation of the former Enzyvant, Altavant, Urovant and Myovant Swiss entities. That is not evidence of four additional occupied addresses. The parent’s group directory corroborates the present address, but its entity-level “manufacturing and sales” business description does not establish equipment, production capacity or GMP operations in this downtown building. The Swiss operator is an additional local lead with null company/site IDs; it is not matched to the V6 Sumitomo Pharma America profile. No floor has been published in the reviewed Swiss address evidence. [SD11] [SD23]

**Windward Bio AG is headquartered in Basel and gives Aeschenplatz 6, 4052 Basel as its contact address.** The live company page describes a clinical-stage respiratory and dermatologic antibody developer with US operations. Retained IDs are `gco_caf84e735acf8e01af6b` and `basel:site:windward-basel-hq`. Discovery/development expertise, clinical progress and financing announcements establish company activity, not laboratories, a new lease or incremental space take at Aeschenplatz. Exact premises and office functions are still required. [SD06]

**Granite Bio AG publishes Aeschenvorstadt 36, 4051 Basel.** It describes a Basel-based antibody developer and shows discovery, translational, clinical and corporate roles. Those company capabilities do not establish that wet laboratories occupy the downtown contact address. Retained IDs are `gco_e5bfdeb96ac5d1afd961` and `basel:site:granite-basel`. The snapshot’s research-function label is therefore not used as a building-level lab specification. [SD07]

**Versant Ventures independently lists its Basel investment office at Aeschenvorstadt 36, CH-4051 Basel.** Its primary offices page places the Ridgeline discovery engine separately at Hochbergerstrasse 60C, outside this district in the Stücki/Klybeck grouping. The downtown investment office is an additional ecosystem operator, not a laboratory campus. Granite and Versant sharing a published street address does not prove a shared demise, a common lease or an incubator operated in this building. [SD14]

**Acadia Pharmaceuticals currently lists a Basel international office at Barfüsserplatz 3, 4051 Basel.** It separately lists a Zug-area office; the presence of that additional Swiss contact does not displace the published Basel office. The existing global profile match is `gco_0d62f5a9a6604c3ba1fd`, but there is no retained Basel site ID. The Swiss contracting entity, local functions, suite and NLA remain open. [SD10]

**Noema Pharma AG also states Barfüsserplatz 3, 4051 Basel as its place of business, but the evidence is a privacy policy explicitly last updated on 28 May 2024.** The live page was re-read on 4 November 2026. It supports a company-published legal/place-of-business address, not independently verified late-2026 physical tenancy. Retained IDs are `gco_938b55cbc12b1d50c8e0` and `basel:site:noema-basel`. Current headquarters occupancy, the exact demise and any shared occupancy or other relationship with Acadia need direct confirmation. A matching street address is insufficient. [SD16]

**Luye Pharma Switzerland AG is at Bäumleingasse 22, 4051 Basel.** The company locations page expressly assigns licensing, business development, clinical development, portfolio management and patents to the Swiss operator. The production, packaging, quality-assurance and R&D services shown elsewhere on that page belong to Miesbach, Germany. This is a source-supported downtown office operator with null V6 IDs, not an imported Basel manufacturing plant. [SD18]

**Regeneron publishes its Basel office in Grosspeter Tower at Grosspeteranlage 29, CH-4052 Basel.** The current global company locations page names both the building and address. The retained global profile is `gco_802518db21f06c8a2e23`; there is no retained Basel site ID. Its separate industrial-operations locations elsewhere are not assigned to this office. Tenant floors, lease counterparty and occupied NLA are not published in the address source. [SD19]

## Campus and building schedule

### Lonza Tower and Lindenhofareal

The current headquarters and its planned redevelopment must remain separate records. The cantonal Ratschlag dated **21 June 2023**, distributed on **23 June 2023**, identifies Lonza AG as owner of parcel **4/380**, with an **approximately 12,000 m² land area**. This is historical official land/perimeter evidence, not leasable floor area or a current title search. Its planning comparison reports **11,500 m² existing BGF** for the Lonza Tower and **32,500 m² additional proposed BGF** across the new-build fields. These are historical gross/planning figures, not tenant occupied area and not current office availability. Source locators are printed page 5 for land/owner and pages 22–23 for BGF. [SD15]

The project operator’s undated page, observed **4 November 2026**, now gives **11,300 m² above-ground Geschossfläche** for the tower and **32,350 m² above-ground Geschossfläche** across the planned new buildings. The new-build program includes **9,600 m² work and service space**, with public-facing ground-floor uses. That subcategory’s measurement standard is not separately defined. The source also says the new buildings include additional offices for Lonza and other business/service uses; it does not quantify Lonza’s take or identify available third-party office demises. [SD12]

The historical BGF and current above-ground program are deliberately not forced to a single number. They differ in date and stated basis; neither is a current NLA measurement. The mixed-use new-build aggregate cannot be presented as office-only pipeline, available life-science space or Lonza occupied area. Current land-register title, Swiss Life’s ownership/development interest and approved project measurements remain to be verified. The sponsors currently name **Lonza AG and Swiss Life Asset Management AG**; **HRS Real Estate AG** is the overall delivery contractor, **Miller & Maranta AG** designs the new buildings and **Burckhardt Architektur AG** the tower renovation. These roles are not interchangeable with legal ownership. [SD12] [SD13]

### Elsässertor

Elsässertor is an existing office/commercial building with an operating Sandoz headquarters, not a new 2026 construction opportunity. The original architect’s undated project page, observed **4 November 2026**, identifies the original construction period as **2002–2005** and reports **5,400 m² Site Area** and **4,800 m² Footprint**. These are historical land and ground-plan metrics. Neither is building GFA or Sandoz lease area. The original project clients, TK3 and TU Batigroup, are not treated as current landlords. No sourced current landlord, tenant NLA or building-wide Sandoz occupancy is available in the reviewed primary evidence. [SD08] [SD09] [SD20]

### Grosspeter Tower

The PSP Swiss Property investment-property record identifies Grosspeter Tower under **Grosspeterstrasse 44, 4052 Basel**, while Regeneron’s company page uses **Grosspeteranlage 29** for the same named tower. Both address forms are retained with their distinct source basis; no entrance coordinate is invented. PSP’s live record names **PSP Management Ltd.** as property manager. The PSP portfolio relationship is source-supported, but the title-holding subsidiary and Regeneron’s lease counterparty need legal/document confirmation. [SD17] [SD19]

Observed **4 November 2026**, the owner’s publication gives **18,002 m² total rentable space** across office, gastronomy and other uses, including an **11,478 m² rentable office component**. Those are building/property figures, not Regeneron’s occupied area. The record supplies no tenant-by-tenant schedule or district vacancy measure. Its use-category percentages are not used as occupancy or vacancy rates. [SD17]

### Other documented office properties

Peter Merian-Strasse 84, Peter Merian Weg 10, Peter Merian-Weg 12, Aeschenplatz 6, Aeschenvorstadt 36, Barfüsserplatz 3 and Bäumleingasse 22 each have company address evidence described above. Current gross areas, tenant demises, landlord identities and lease schedules are not established. They remain separate address/property records rather than invented contiguous campuses. [SD02] [SD03] [SD04] [SD06] [SD07] [SD10] [SD14] [SD16] [SD18]

Aeschengraben 27 has independent BeOne and Sumitomo office evidence. Baloise’s **16 September 2020** release establishes the neighbouring Baloise Park office/hotel development and a historical office allocation in Park West, but the release does not give number 27. It is not sufficient by itself to assign a Baloise landlord, a current building area or an available floor to these tenants. A property-level address/title match is the next step. Historical hotel opening forecasts are not carried forward as current availability. [SD05] [SD11] [SD21]

## Development pipeline

The material sourced footprint action is **Lindenhof**, not a inferred sector-wide expansion. The project operator states that the selected design was developed into the building-application scheme from **early 2025** and integrated with the Lonza Tower renovation. This is design development, not evidence that construction started in 2025. The dated sponsor release of **19 August 2026** announces applications during August 2026 for the renovation and new buildings. The reviewed sources do not independently establish permit issuance, expiry of appeals or a contractor notice to proceed. [SD13] [SD22]

The operator’s live schedule, observed **4 November 2026**, puts the permitting process through **2027**, Lonza’s move into an interim solution and anticipated renovation/construction start in **2027**, planned completion of tower renovation at **end 2028**, and planned new-build completion in **summer 2030**. These are operator forecasts, not current possession dates or contracted deliveries. The temporary premises are not named, and no take-up area or external leasing requirement is quantified. Lonza’s permanent headquarters is intended to remain on the site; the interim move must not be labelled permanent closure or immediate giveback. [SD13]

No additional source-supported 2025/2026 building take, surrender, refurbishment or planned lab delivery was established for the remaining downtown companies. Corporate financing, pipeline progress, redomiciliation and legal consolidation do not substitute for physical footprint evidence. Sandoz’s completed headquarters inauguration is a relevant historical occupancy action, not a new 2026 move. [SD06] [SD08] [SD11]

## Availability evidence

PSP’s live Grosspeter Tower record, observed **4 November 2026**, advertises an office of **781 m² on the first floor** and an office of **430 m² on the sixth floor**, both at Grosspeterstrasse 44. Their basis is advertised office area; net/gross convention is not specified. The company-side source does not link either offer to Regeneron. These are practical office enquiries, but not inspected vacancy, a life-science giveback, lab-ready suites or a district availability total. [SD17]

The owner record does not establish rent, firm possession date, subdivision rights, landlord works, tenant fit-out, incentives or lease expiry. Those remain explicit gaps rather than assumed market terms. A written current availability schedule and premises inspection are necessary before underwriting. Lindenhof’s work/service program is a planned mixed-use program, not an openly marketed office offer; no sourced available area or third-party release date is established there. [SD12] [SD17]

## Property due diligence

1. **Lonza/Lindenhof.** obtain application references, permit and appeal status, approved area schedules and notice to proceed. Search parcel 4/380 title and encumbrances; distinguish Lonza’s title from Swiss Life’s development/investment role. Obtain the precise current NLA, the 2027 interim location and area, move phasing, tower return timing and new-build Lonza/third-party allocations.
2. **Grosspeter.** request written confirmation from PSP Management that the first- and sixth-floor offers remain available, with possession dates, measurement standard, floor plans, subdivision, landlord works, service-cost basis and lease/rent proposals. Obtain Regeneron’s separate lease abstract before claiming any release or expansion. The owner page names property contact Kaan Yilmazer; contact details are available at the cited source. [SD17]
3. **Sandoz, Bayer, Straumann and Moderna.** request tenant demise plans and lease abstracts covering the contracting entity, landlord/title holder, occupied NLA, term, breaks, options, incentives and dated footprint changes. Bayer requires divisional/legal-entity allocations; Straumann requires pedestrian versus vehicle-access separation.
4. **Shared published addresses.** directly confirm Noema’s late-2026 physical presence and separate Acadia demise at Barfüsserplatz 3. Verify Aeschengraben 27’s building identity/title, BeOne’s within-floor demise and Sumitomo’s floor. Establish Granite/Versant’s actual co-location arrangement, if any, without assuming a common lease or laboratories.
5. **Small/private operators.** obtain Windward, Granite and Luye office floor schedules and site-specific functions; ask for any separately located research premises. Local workforce, rents, lease expiry, lab ventilation/containment, floor loading, loading access and GMP or clean-room specifications remain unknown unless supplied by the relevant company/landlord.
6. **Mapping.** match each newly verified address to official address/building identifiers before inserting a street pin or occupied-building outline downstream. A published company address is not a surveyed footprint. Do not reuse city centroids, logo positions or guessed coordinates; retain source postal designations and alternate access addresses.

### Evidence gaps and legacy labels

The supplied brochure’s Railway Station/Downtown map provides logo-only discovery labels, not current tenancy or addresses. The verified additions above were resolved through company pages. The remaining legacy cases stay outside the occupied inventory.

**Ironwood/former VectivBio** has retained company ID `gco_7bad8eba1dea19b23941` and site `basel:site:ironwood-basel-former-vectivbio-operations`. The inspected V6 site’s `not_active` status is tied to a corporate merger source, not verified physical closure evidence. This report does not adopt that status as closure, giveback or availability. A current premises-specific filing, company response or landlord record is required.

**Mirum** has retained research profile `claude_csv:5c6eedfb4fa8:293`. Its live international contact is **Baarerstrasse 22, 6300 Zug**, outside this district and outside BS/BL. That does not prove a historical Basel office closed; it means the reviewed current company page does not support retaining a downtown Basel office from a brochure logo or third-party address. [SD24]

**Galapagos** remains an unresolved legacy map label. The reviewed current Lakefront locations page does not furnish a Basel address; neither that omission nor corporate strategy/rebranding is used as physical closure evidence. Entity succession and any retained Basel premises require explicit confirmation. The ambiguous **“indig”** map label requires an exact entity identification before address work. [SD25]

No institutional research campus was established inside this assigned district. University and hospital campuses elsewhere in Basel have not been imported to add apparent depth. No local workforce, occupied area, suite, lease expiry, rent or lab/manufacturing capability has been invented. Current property-title and lease gaps are specified above rather than reported as zero.

## Submarket aerials

Retain aerial ID **`basel-downtown-sbb-aeschen`**. Its existing Swiss federal SWISSIMAGE export and print exhibit are orientation assets, not live imagery, verified lease outlines or campus perimeters. The imagery export was retrieved on **2 November 2026**; acquisition years remain unresolved. The retained view is an analytical SBB/Aeschen/downtown frame, not a statutory submarket boundary.

The [existing downtown print/aerial exhibit]([retained internal document] and [existing interactive aerial exhibit]([retained internal document] remain untouched. The JSON identifies the source-safe image and exact company/site associations. Acadia, Luye, Sumitomo, Versant and Regeneron require official address-point matching and downstream map integration; this research does not create guessed street pins or assert that those additions already appear in the existing exhibit. No application/shared-master files or private original brochures have been copied or edited.

Original private brochures/presentations are excluded. Read-only Drive filename queries for Basel, Lonza, Lindenhof, JLL and Life Sciences Hub returned no additional files on 4 November 2026. propertyEvidence.name: ALL
propertyEvidence.operator: SENN Resources AG; future SIP ALLabs programme
propertyEvidence.status: construction/delivery_pipeline; scheduled ready 2027-01-01, not current occupied stock
propertyEvidence.areaBasis: SENN Nutzfläche / usable building area; allbasel.com separately markets over 20,000 m² workspaces
propertyEvidence.caveat: SENN states construction began 2024 and completion 2026, with occupancy from 1 January 2027. propertyEvidence.name: ALL — current advertised shell letting offer
propertyEvidence.areaBasis: Exclusive office/lab rental areas including source-described Evaluationsfläche, split between ground and first floor; shared-area shares additional
propertyEvidence.caveat: 4,000 m² first-floor area divisible from 600 m² and 1,100 m² ground-floor area, shell basis. Obtain a timestamped live space schedule, reservation status and definition of Evaluationsfläche. Do not infer BIIE demised area from the building total minus this offer.

propertyEvidence.name: ALLabs — pre-equipped private laboratory programme
propertyEvidence.operator: Switzerland Innovation Park Basel Area AG
propertyEvidence.address: ALL, Hegenheimermattweg 169, 4123 Allschwil — building-level future programme reference
propertyEvidence.areaBasis: Advertised individual laboratory format, not total programme area or known vacant quantity
propertyEvidence.caveat: Private labs offered as 25 m² or 40 m² formats with benches/sink, fume hood, Class II biosafety cabinet, incubator and basic equipment plus shared support. Class II cabinet does not itself certify a building biosafety level. BIIE-equipment access is conditional, not automatic. No number of unreserved units or rent disclosed.

propertyEvidence.name: HOPE
propertyEvidence.operator: SENN; developed with Rudolf Geigy-Stiftung according to SENN
propertyEvidence.areaBasis: SENN Nutzfläche / usable area of whole future office/commercial building
propertyEvidence.owner: SENN, St. Gallen as disclosed; precise legal title entity not specified

Developer says areas from about 150 m², while operator gives 130–8,000 m²; secure a live schedule instead of treating those as surveyed available areas. Historical brochure's 8,000 m² remaining and floor illustrations stay historical.
