clusters.detailedNarrative:
# Allschwil / Bachgraben / Main Campus — BL

Allschwil is an operating laboratory, office and life-science equipment-production district, not merely a list of Basel-area company headquarters. The immediate property choices are existing Main Campus HQ laboratories and HORTUS offices, subject to live space confirmation. ALL is a future laboratory/office letting opportunity for January 2027. HOPE is an office/commercial development for 2028 occupancy, while SCALE is a planned 2030 build-to-suit programme. None of these sources establishes a district vacancy rate, a quantified tenant giveback or aggregate occupied area. [AL01] [AL02] [AL06] [AL08] [AL09]

**Research cutoff: 4 November 2026.** Undated live company, property and institution pages below were observed on that date; their publication dates remain unknown. The historical supplied Main Campus overview is dated only by an inferred 8 October 2025 filename. The supplied JLL/Basel Area hub extract is dated by 31 October 2025 PDF metadata. Both establish what the material said at that time, not current tenancy or availability. The JSON records each quantity's scope, source, observation date and area basis. No private original brochure is included in these outputs.

## Occupier inventory

### Source-backed company street addresses

**Alentis Therapeutics AG — Hegenheimermattweg 167A, 4123 Allschwil.** The company's contact block supplies its own address. Its business is anti-Claudin-1 antibody and antibody-drug-conjugate development. The park's laboratory page quotes Alentis's use of private labs, which is stronger evidence of a laboratory operation than directory residency alone. The address still does not identify a demised suite, floor or occupied area. Retain company ID `gco_5554a017a5a79fc7ba31` and site ID `basel:site:alentis-allschwil`. No sourced local space action follows automatically from the company's partnerships or financing. [AL10] [AL11]

**Basilea Pharmaceutica International Ltd, Allschwil — Hegenheimermattweg 167b, 4123 Allschwil.** The current company footer confirms the street address. A park interview dated 19 August 2026 describes dedicated R&D laboratories, offices, communal and quieter work areas. It dates the consolidation from two Basel-city sites to 2022, not 2026. That is current operating-site corroboration and a historical consolidation, not fresh leasing demand. The brochure's employee testimonial is not adopted as current local headcount. Company ID `gco_711f5ce68856e14aa757`; site ID `basel:site:basilea-allschwil`. [AL12] [AL13]

**Bright Peak Therapeutics — Hegenheimermattweg 167D, 4123 Allschwil.** This is the company-published Allschwil contact location. Bright Peak describes biotechnology work in protein-engineered multifunctional immunotherapies and co-location in Switzerland and San Diego. Main Campus material also identifies its presence. The actual local laboratory allocation, manufacturing role and tenant area are not disclosed. Company ID `gco_227531de5eb003ab5d9c`; site ID `basel:site:bright-peak-allschwil`. [AL02] [AL14] [AL15]

**Idorsia Pharmaceuticals Ltd — Hegenheimermattweg 91, 4123 Allschwil.** This is a separate headquarters estate, not an assumed suite in Main Campus HQ. The company assigns discovery, development, registration, production oversight, quality, safety and corporate coordination responsibilities to this location. Responsibility for production does not establish a licensed commercial production plant at the address. A company release of 27 September 2022 says an Allschwil R&D building was sold to an unnamed private Swiss company and leased back from 1 October 2022 under a long-term laboratory/office agreement. It does not identify the precise sold-building address, current owner, rent or expiry; it must not be generalized into tenure for the whole estate. [AL16] [AL17]

The 20 December 2024 restructuring announcement anticipated cost reductions becoming largely effective in the second quarter of 2025. Its workforce reduction was global, not a verified Allschwil count. This is a reason to request a current floor-use and lease update, not evidence of vacant laboratories, a surrendered building or a sublease opportunity. Company ID `gco_3ff18fc6f69e8f2956b6`; site ID `basel:site:idorsia-allschwil`. [AL18]

**SKAN AG / SKAN Group AG — Kreuzstrasse 5, 4123 Allschwil.** The company address is retained from the already verified aerial coverage/contact evidence. The current headquarters page describes two production halls, isolator and filling-system equipment, R&D, digital systems, biological-indicator and analytical laboratories, lifecycle services and the SKAN Academy. The institutional property implication is a mixed equipment-engineering, production, laboratory and office operation. It is not a disclosed drug-product manufacturing capacity. [AL19] [AL20]

SKAN calls this a **5,000 m² site** on its undated headquarters page, observed 4 November 2026. That is the company source's site-description basis; it does not define land, gross building, usable, leased or occupied area. It is therefore not stored as a verified tenant-occupied footprint. The park also lists SKAN in its community, but that does not establish a second headquarters suite. Company ID `gco_7389682351a722140321`; site ID `basel:site:skan-allschwil-hq`. [AL02] [AL19]

**T3 Pharmaceuticals AG — Hegenheimermattweg 167A, 4123 Allschwil.** Reuse the existing verified correction: the government registered contact identifies the company at the address; the park's 24 September 2025 account describes continuing laboratory R&D after acquisition and the live resident listing corroborates presence. The source describes furnished/custom laboratories and manufacturing activity, but supplies no move date, measured area, commercial production scale or GMP designation. The address is company-specific registered-contact evidence, not a measured suite. Parent attribution to Boehringer Ingelheim is separate from physical status: acquisition is not closure evidence. Company ID `gco_4770f3a112b9769fac17`; site ID `basel:site:t3-allschwil`. [AL21] [AL22] [AL23] [AL24]

**Becton Dickinson AG — Rudolf Geigy-Strasse 3, 4123 Allschwil, HORTUS.** BD's own Allschwil location page now supports the company street address. The park's 17 June 2025 account describes the new HORTUS workspace as already opened; its publication date is not independently established lease commencement. This is an office/base and customer-support location. The sources do not establish a local manufacturing plant, exact laboratory activity, suite area or workforce. The Google Maps link on BD's page appears inconsistent with the written new address; use the written address for later official lookup, not the link's coordinates. Retain company ID `gco_3f314dfde5f2902e7d47` and site ID `basel:site:bd-main-campus`. [AL05] [AL25] [AL26]

### Residency references and unresolved district leads

**Alloy Therapeutics** (`gco_d52ad2a2b5ecf1d60a00`, `basel:site:alloy-main-campus`) and **Neurocrine Biosciences** (`gco_83cf6169ad5cf8eb3372`, `basel:site:neurocrine-allschwil`) remain operator-reported Main Campus residents. The park contact is not their company suite or verified company street address. Local functional scope, workforce and measured footprint remain unknown. [AL02]

**Viatris** (`gco_d1fd561cce24c3ea3c50`, `basel:site:viatris-hortus-main-campus`) is named on the current HORTUS property site, but the building address is not automatically Viatris's own operating address. Obtain company-specific or official-register corroboration of the legal entity, address and local function before creating a street-level company pin. [AL01] [AL05]

**Johnson & Johnson** (`gco_2cde2ccc283a7fd4e3fc`, `basel:site:jnj-basel`) is identified by the park in HQ. J&J's Swiss location page describes Basel Campus clinical-development, supply-chain, quality, digital/data and support functions spanning Innovative Medicine and MedTech. It does not assign them to a specific Main Campus suite or street address. The retained V6 site is labelled Basel/BS even though its address text is explicitly the Allschwil park-contact reference. Preserve the ID and flag that canton/city classification for downstream correction; do not relocate an unverified company point. A historical Actelion transaction address is not current J&J operating-address proof. The separately encountered S-GE story has a 2025 publication date but links older social posts, so its publication date is not adopted as a verified 2025 hub-opening event. [AL01] [AL02] [AL27]

**Orbis Medicines** (`gco_d96230457ee4d556f0ff`, `basel:site:orbis-allschwil`) remains unresolved. V6 retains current operator residency but company-stated Copenhagen and Lausanne locations, including an October 2026 update and Biopôle company record. This is a location conflict, not a proven current Allschwil operating site and not a closure. Keep address and coordinates null pending company/operator resolution. [AL02] [AL28] [AL29]

**Abbott Products Operations AG** is a district lead, matched only at parent level to `gco_1f16a12a23c6de41e165`. Abbott appears in the operator's district context and the supplied schematic. Searches suggested an Allschwil street address, but the successfully extracted current company directory did not establish that block and browser rendering was blank. Its separate Swiss directory identifies Baar, outside this corridor. No Allschwil street address or plant function is promoted on search snippets alone. The supplied/observed evidence also does not establish an independent Thermo Fisher manufacturing facility here; the park private-lab page describes a consumables supply-center service instead. [AL01] [AL30] [AL31]

## Campus and building schedule

### Separate the land estate, building owner and park operator

BaseLink is not a synonym for the entire Bachgraben district or for one building. BSB's release dated **8 May 2017** identifies a **75,000 m² land estate** at Hegenheimermattweg and names Bürgerspital Basel and EBM as landowners. It describes building-right grants to SENN and Fortimo and a reserved Swiss TPH plot. The date printed on the page controls; its URL slug is misleading. This is historical land and building-right evidence, not current floor area or certified present title. [AL32]

The workspace operator is **Switzerland Innovation Park Basel Area AG**, contacted at Hegenheimermattweg 167A. Institutional underwriting should separately identify the landowner, building-right holder, registered property owner, investment manager and headlease/sublease operator. A campus operating brand does not establish every company's landlord. [AL02]

### Main Campus HQ — existing laboratory and office building

SENN describes **50,000 m² Nutzfläche**, or usable whole-building area, on its undated current page observed 4 November 2026. Its headline names Pensimo and its ownership FAQ names **Immobilien-Anlagestiftung Turidomus**. The manager's portfolio provides stronger address-level detail at a stated reporting date of **31 December 2025**:

- **Hegenheimermattweg 167a/167b.** **20,594 m² commercial usable area**, with build year 2022 and acquisition year 2023.
- **Hegenheimermattweg 167c/167d.** **29,063 m² commercial usable area**, with build year 2023 and acquisition year 2024.

These are owner portfolio holdings, not demised tenant areas or vacant suites. Retain both source-defined property records rather than force them into the developer's rounded whole-building figure. The historical brochure's **over 40,000 m² labs/office** wording is a separate, undefined area convention, not an occupied-area measurement. [AL03] [AL04]

There is a concrete address discrepancy: SENN's FAQ gives **Hegenheimermattweg 170**, while the owner portfolio and company/institution evidence identify the 167a–167d blocks. Do not create a new HQ building pin at 170 without official resolution. The milestone text is also mixed: SENN's project table says completion 2022 and its FAQ says operating since 2021; the operator says inauguration 2022 and the owner holdings have 2022/2023 build years. Existing operation is established, but individual phase/opening dates need the owner's completion schedule. [AL01] [AL03] [AL04]

The developer describes office/laboratory suitability up to **BSL II** and shell or tailored fit-outs. That is property capability marketing, not a blanket statement that every suite is commissioned or licensed for that use. The park distinguishes shared benches, furnished private biology/chemistry/analytical labs and custom build-outs. Equipment provision varies by model: private-lab residents supply their specialized instruments. Autoclaving, waste handling, glassware washing, gas/water and storage services are described, but unit-level access and service terms require an offer. [AL03] [AL11] [AL31]

### HORTUS — existing office building, not assumed wet-lab stock

**Rudolf Geigy-Strasse 3** is supported by the property site and BD's company location page. SENN names **SENN Resources AG** as owner and gives approximately **10,000 m² Nutzfläche**, observed 4 November 2026, with an explicit **June 2025 opening**. Its physical offer is offices/coworking, meeting rooms, food and fitness amenities. The research-related acronym and life-science tenants do not make it a substantiated wet-lab building. [AL05] [AL06] [AL25]

The historical brochure says “Full House” and approximately 10,000 m² office workspace. That is dated 2025 source-period information. Today's coworking/office enquiries and tenant labels neither confirm total occupation nor quantify an available suite. [AL01] [AL05] [AL06]

### Institutional buildings and entrances

The University of Basel **Department of Biomedical Engineering** documents its physical location at **Hegenheimermattweg 167B/C**. Its physical entrance is Core C on the second floor and its study area is Core B on the second floor. It separately specifies **167A for postal mail**. This is an important street/entrance distinction for building-level aerials and visitor access; the postal address must not replace the physical departmental entrance. No departmental occupied-area figure is supplied. [AL33]

**Swiss TPH** is currently at **Kreuzstrasse 2, Allschwil**. It conducts research, education and diagnostic/expert work; its travel-medicine facility at Aeschenplatz 2 is in Basel-Stadt and outside this record. The current building is separate from its future HOPE commitment. Current headquarters area, title and lease remain gaps. [AL34] [AL35]

The Innovation Garage, university Innovation Office, CSEM and University Hospital skills/simulation references are explicitly encountered in park/internal material, but institution-specific street, suite and occupied-area evidence has not been obtained here. The brochure's **over 500 m² innovation space**, tied to a 2021 timeline entry in the inferred October 2025 document, remains historical and undefined. Parking counts are not floor area. [AL01] [AL02]

## Development pipeline

### ALL — construction completion and occupation are different milestones

**ALL, Hegenheimermattweg 169**, is owned by **SENN Resources AG** according to the developer. SENN gives approximately **20,500 m² usable building area** and a construction programme beginning in 2024, with completion in 2026 and readiness from **1 January 2027**. The dedicated property page separately markets “over 20,000 m²” workspace. The distinction between construction completion and occupation resolves the basic 2026/2027 programme difference; neither statement certifies completed November 2026 occupation. [AL07] [AL08]

The developer says the **top three floors are let to BIIE**. This is future tenant commitment, not current Allschwil institute occupancy. The institute's current public contact remains c/o ETH D-BSSE, Klingelbergstrasse 48, Basel-Stadt, with deliveries to Schanzenstrasse 44. BIIE's tenant area must not be computed by multiplying floors or subtracting other offers from the building total. [AL07] [AL08] [AL36]

ALL's shell specifications describe completed circulation, risers, toilets, showers and laboratory-infrastructure rooms. Cooling, cold water, power, ventilation, osmosis water, carbon dioxide, nitrogen and compressed-air connections are described. Partitioning, finishes and tenant-specific installations remain fit-out responsibilities. Ask for the commissioned utility schedule, permitted use, landlord-versus-tenant scope and laboratory operating approvals; broad production/laboratory suitability is not GMP authorization. [AL37]

**ALLabs** is a future pre-equipped private-laboratory programme opening in **January 2027**. The undated operator page observed at cutoff offers **25 m² and 40 m² private-lab formats**, with benches, sink, fume hood, Class II biosafety cabinet, incubator and basic equipment plus shared support infrastructure. These are offered formats, not known unreserved suites or a measured programme total. A Class II cabinet is not itself a building biosafety-level certification. Access to BIIE equipment is expressly conditional, not part of automatic tenant entitlement. [AL38]

### HOPE — office/commercial development, future Swiss TPH space

**HOPE, Hegenheimermattweg 165**, is developer-reported as under construction. SENN names itself as owner, describes development with Rudolf Geigy-Stiftung, gives **10,250 m² Nutzfläche** and completion **2027/28**, with occupation from **2028**. The park page says opening at the end of 2028. The exact handover milestone needs confirmation. The developer says Swiss TPH has secured the top floor, with lower office floors and public-facing ground-floor commercial/service uses offered. This is not evidenced wet-laboratory supply, nor proof of TPH leaving Kreuzstrasse 2. [AL01] [AL09]

SENN offers areas from about **150 m²**; the operator advertises a different **130–8,000 m²** range. Both are current future-offer descriptions on undated pages observed at cutoff, not a surveyed late-2026 availability schedule. The brochure's 8,000 m² remaining statement stays historical. [AL01] [AL09]

### SCALE — planned 2030 supply, not verified construction

SENN names itself as owner of **SCALE**, and the specialized property site gives approximately **28,000 m² total usable space** and target occupation in **2030**. Its technical planning status is **June 2026**. Office, laboratory and GMP-production use are planned options, not current licensed manufacturing capacity. No reviewed primary source establishes an exact SCALE street number or actual construction start. Do not borrow ALL's address from a listing portal. [AL39] [AL40]

The microsite describes approximately **4,500 m² lettable typical-floor area** and a smallest technical unit from **369 m²**, while other text uses 350 m² and SENN's page markets a 2,000 m² minimum. Other per-floor figures also differ. These are indicative planning/marketing formats with different scopes, not guaranteed demises. Floor loads, HVAC capacities, goods-lift dimensions and vibration classes are explicitly available on request, not disclosed values. Obtain approved plans and a signed delivery/fit-out specification before underwriting laboratory or manufacturing suitability. [AL39] [AL40]

## Availability evidence

For an immediate search, HQ has current laboratory/office enquiry offers. The operator says it is “almost full,” which is not a vacancy measurement. Its private-lab page offers a **12–105 m² format range**, observed 4 November 2026 on an undated page, with “check availability” rather than an unreserved-unit schedule. HORTUS has office/coworking enquiries, with no verified available-area quantity. No current company lease expiry or authorised giveback is disclosed here. [AL01] [AL02] [AL31]

For a 2027 search, ALL's dedicated current offer is **5,100 m²**, split into **4,000 m² on the first floor**, divisible from **600 m²**, and **1,100 m² on the ground floor**. The source defines these as exclusive office/laboratory rental areas including an *Evaluationsfläche*, with common-area shares additional. That German term needs contractual measurement clarification. The figures are future shell letting offers, observed at cutoff, not physically vacant space ready now. SENN's separate FAQ says nearly 1,400 m² on the ground floor; keep the dedicated offer and flag the disagreement, rather than mixing or adding both. [AL07] [AL08] [AL37]

The same current offer publishes **CHF 260/m²/year for office shell**, **CHF 280/m²/year for laboratory shell**, and **CHF 170/m²/year for optional exclusive basement space**. These are asking rates from an undated developer page observed 4 November 2026. They are not achieved rents, fitted-lab all-in costs or comparable company lease economics. Service charges, taxes, fit-out obligations, incentives, basement quantity and actual reservation status need confirmation. No CHF/EUR/USD conversion is made. [AL37]

HOPE and SCALE are future office/commercial and build-to-suit enquiries, respectively. Their total programme areas are not current vacancy. No source-backed anchor lease for SCALE, measured remaining HOPE balance or unreserved ALLabs unit count is established. The ecosystem's operator headline of **80,000 m² current capacity growing to 120,000 m²** also cannot be used as an occupancy or vacancy denominator: its area convention and exact building scope are unspecified, while the historical brochure and several current developer pages still use 115,000 m². [AL01] [AL09] [AL39] [AL40]

## Property due diligence

1. **Get the live space schedule.** Ask SENN/SIP for room, floor, exclusive/common area, fitted/shell condition, reservation, lease status and earliest commissioned occupation for every offered HQ, HORTUS, ALL, HOPE and SCALE space. Resolve ALL ground-floor and HOPE/SCALE minimum-format differences before presenting an availability list.
2. **Confirm title and measurement.** Ask Pensimo/Turidomus for the 167a/b and 167c/d title/building-right map, current tenancy roll and owner-approved gross/usable/lettable schedule. Resolve HQ FAQ address 170 and phase chronology. Obtain current BaseLink ground-title and building-right terms rather than applying the 2017 release universally.
3. **Make ALL's delivery bankable.** Obtain the contractual handover date, permit/use status, commissioning certificates, fit-out split, utility capacities, BIIE demised area and relocation timetable, plus ALLabs unreserved-unit list. A building programme is not a guarantee that a specific laboratory can run experiments on that date.
4. **Test Idorsia's physical outcome.** Request a dated 2025/2026 Allschwil floor-use plan, current R&D-building landlord and lease/options schedule, and any authorised sublease/surrender or consolidation notice. Until then, financial restructuring is not a giveback or vacant-lab lead.
5. **Separate Swiss TPH expansion from relocation.** Obtain institutional confirmation of its HOPE top-floor commitment, measured area, fit-out/occupation dates and effect on current Kreuzstrasse 2 operations. No current-building closure is inferred.
6. **Verify SCALE before presenting a street pin or commissioned capacity.** Obtain the official address/plot and permit plans, construction-start and preletting status, approved demises, delivery guarantee and technical schedules. Planned GMP use is not a production licence.
7. **Resolve residency references individually.** Company/official records must establish physical addresses and legal tenants for J&J, Viatris, Alloy, Neurocrine and the remaining roster. Ask Orbis and the park to resolve its contradictory location evidence. Do not use acquisitions, corporate financial scale or the park footer as a substitute.
8. **Complete tenant economics and local scale.** Suite, occupied area by explicit convention, local employees as of a stated date, lease expiry/options, achieved rent, service and fit-out obligations remain unknown for the company rows. The JSON stores null rather than zero.

## Submarket aerials

Retain district unit **`basel-allschwil-bachgraben-main-campus`** and coverage ID **`basel-allschwil`**. Existing source-safe files are the [district aerial]([retained internal document] [print map]([retained internal document] and [interactive aerial]([retained internal document]

The underlying SWISSIMAGE WMS retrieval is **2 November 2026**, not the imagery capture date. The district frame is analyst-selected, not a surveyed estate, formal submarket polygon or municipal boundary. No new pins, street-level crops or app/shared-master edits were made in this research assignment. Downstream street-level views should use verified company-address evidence for the documented rows, a different symbol for campus orientation, and official address resolution before BD/ALL/HOPE crops. SCALE, residency-only companies, the HQ 170 discrepancy and BD's inconsistent map link require resolution first. An aerial image does not verify current tenants, occupied area or project completion. [AL41]

## Coverage and evidence gaps

The full JSON preserves **54 distinct resident links** observed by deterministic extraction from the Main Campus HQ page on **4 November 2026**. That is an operator-directory denominator, not 54 verified life-science company sites, a building rent roll or a district census. It includes service providers and non-life-science references. The record keeps all encountered retained profiles and separates verified company addresses, institutions, property buildings, future programmes and unresolved leads; no eight-row cap is imposed on the underlying inventory. [AL02]

The full linked roster is: abc biopply AG; Alentis Therapeutics; Alloy Therapeutics; Altamira Therapeutics; Arcondis; Axxam Spa; Baselaunch; Basilea; BD; Blackway Biosciences AG; Boderm Pharmaceutical S.A.; Braunpat AG; Bright Peak Therapeutics; Captor Therapeutics; Cavenagh; Clinilabs; Crystallise! AG; CSEM; Cview Consult; Department of Biomedical Engineering at the University of Basel; ELDICO Scientific; Engimmune Therapeutics AG; Fy Cappa Biologics; Gubra; Hamilton AG; Hemastatx; Hemex; Horváth; ICT Scouts; Ilonov; InCephalo; J&J Campus Basel; Monix Health AG; Nandasi Pharma Advisors; Neo Medical; Neurocrine; Onena Medicines; Peleven; PharmaBiome; Phialogics AG; PHOENIQS; Preclina Europe GmbH; Revnuu; Sironax; SKAN; Skills Lab & Simulation Center, University Hospital Basel; Solute Guard Therapeutics AG; Spheroidals / University Hospital Basel; Swiss Aviation Software; Swiss Biome Institute; T3 Pharmaceuticals; Viatris; WuXi XDC; and Yokogawa Innovation Switzerland. Each JSON lead retains its resident URL; directory display names do not certify Swiss legal entities. [AL02]

The all-sites directory also contains Novartis Campus and Jura entries, so it is not copied wholesale into Allschwil. Resident-by-resident company-address checks and an official Bachgraben building/occupier denominator remain outstanding.

NBE is not used to fill the Allschwil inventory. The supplied current correction identifies its operating R&D address at **Hochbergerstrasse 60I, Basel-Stadt**, following a completed Basel R&D opening in 2025. That facility belongs in the separate Basel-Stadt record. Likewise, T3's acquisition and Orbis's location conflict are not used as closure evidence. [AL21] [AL24] [AL42]

## Source and coverage notes
Historical internal source locators are retained as metadata only in the JSON: supplied Main Campus overview extract, pp. 5, 10–11, 15, 18–20, 27, 37, 39, 42–43 and 46–48; supplied JLL/Basel Area hub extract, pp. 1, 20–21 and 29. No original private PDF or brochure-download link is distributed.

clusters.detailedNarrative:
# Reinach / Aesch / Therwil — Basel-Landschaft

**Research cutoff: 4 November 2026.**

This corridor has established analytical and bioanalytical laboratories in Reinach, an oral-solid pharmaceutical packaging and warehousing facility in Aesch, and respiratory-device manufacturing in Therwil. Reinach also has two directly advertised property/operator propositions: TechCenter Reinach and iCITY Reinach. These are not evidence of a single life-science campus, a regional vacancy rate, or an aggregate leased footprint. Current operator websites support the presence and offers described below; they do not provide a complete rent roll or proof of all building occupations. [RA01] [RA02] [RA03] [RA04] [RA05] [RA06] [RA07]

Reinach, Aesch and Therwil are listed by the canton as Basel-Landschaft municipalities. Dornach and Witterswil are outside this BL inventory: the official Solothurn municipality register lists both in its Dorneck district, in the version effective 1 January 2026. Do not place nearby Solothurn technology parks into the BL pipeline. [RA15] [RA16]

## Occupier inventory

### Intertek — analytical laboratory, Reinach

Intertek (Schweiz) AG directly describes its Reinach analytical laboratory as providing pharmaceutical and medical-device testing, chemical and polymer analysis, extractables and leachables, analytical method development and validation, stability studies, and release/QC testing. It reports a **2,200 m² Swiss testing laboratory**, with Reinach as the scope. The page does not define a gross/net measurement standard, or say that this is the total company lease including offices and ancillary accommodation. Publication date is unknown; the claim was observed on 4 November 2026 and is primary company-reported, not independently measured. [RA03]

The same page says the laboratory meets GLP requirements, is on the WHO list of prequalified QC laboratories, holds GMP certification, has ISO certification for specified methods and has been FDA inspected. These are company statements about the test facility, not evidence of a ready-to-let GMP production suite or quantified utility capacity. Obtain the current certificates and their scope before relying on them in underwriting. [RA03]

There is a material address conflict. The global analytical-lab page publishes **TechCenter Reinach, Kägenstrasse 15, CH-4153 Reinach**. Intertek's Swiss legal notice publishes **TechCenter Reinach, Kägenstraße 18, CH-4153 Reinach**. Both source addresses are retained. They must not be silently harmonized, treated as two separate occupied laboratories, or used to create a definitive roof/parcel pin. Ask Intertek to confirm the laboratory entrance, legal correspondence address, building identifier and occupied demises. [RA03] [RA08]

### Swiss BioQuant — bioanalytical CRO, Reinach

Swiss BioQuant AG publishes **Kägenstrasse 18, 4153 Reinach** on its own location page. Its services include LC-MS/MS and ligand-binding assay method development, validation and sample analysis for small and large molecules in non-clinical and clinical studies, plus qPCR bioanalysis for cell and gene therapies. It describes a GLP-compliant test facility and bioanalytical regulatory documentation. This establishes a functioning contract research operation, not therapeutic manufacturing. TechCenter also explicitly identifies Swiss BioQuant among its on-site businesses. [RA04] [RA09] [RA02]

No current primary source reviewed discloses Swiss BioQuant's occupied area, floor, suite, ownership interest, lease expiry, rent or local employment. Do not allocate TechCenter's usable-space total to this company. Its company and site IDs are null in this canton supplement because no matching V6 master profile was identified.

### Thermo Fisher Scientific / Life Technologies — company-published Reinach address

Thermo Fisher's official locations page publishes **Neuhofstrasse 11, 4153 Reinach, TechCenter**. Its structured geographic label then says “Basel, CH-BS,” which conflicts with the street locality and the official canton municipality register. Retain the source's address text, but classify the physical locality as Reinach, BL; do not inherit the incorrect BS label. The official page is undated and was observed on 4 November 2026. It supports a company-published location, not a specified local production, R&D or warehousing function. [RA10] [RA15]

The existing global company ID **gco_6cf2212dff0779e17130** is retained for Thermo Fisher Scientific. No existing Reinach site ID was found, so siteId remains null. Life Technologies legal-branch attribution, exact local activities and demised space remain confirmation items. iCITY currently publishes the same street address; this is not evidence that Thermo Fisher moved out or that iCITY took over its entire footprint. [RA07] [RA10]

### Acino — pharmaceutical packaging and warehousing, Aesch

Acino's own locations page lists **Acino Pharma AG, Pfeffingerring 205, CH-4147 Aesch**. Its manufacturing-site description specifically assigns Aesch to primary and secondary packaging of oral-solid dosage forms and warehousing. The site reports handling high-potency products up to **OEB 3+**, **five packaging lines**, and a high-speed line capable of **500 blisters per minute**. These figures refer to the Aesch facility's company-stated capabilities; their publication date is unknown and they were observed on 4 November 2026. They are not actual throughput, spare capacity, an area measurement or a building-wide certification. The Aesch detail was read in the company's loaded page HTML because static text extraction omitted its interactive country content. [RA05] [RA06]

Acino's site labels the company as part of Arcera. Its pharmaceutical network's bulk-production activities must not all be assigned to Aesch: the local source statement supports packaging and warehousing, not an inference of API synthesis or bulk-tablet manufacturing at this address. Neither corporate parentage nor an acquisition is closure evidence. No reviewed primary source supplies Aesch land or floor area, landlord/title, lease terms, warehouse pallet capacity, vacancies or a sourced 2025/2026 expansion or contraction. [RA05] [RA06]

### Sentec — respiratory medical-device manufacturing, Therwil

Sentec directly lists **Therwil, Switzerland — Manufacturing Location** and publishes **Ringstrasse 39, CH-4106 Therwil BL** on its contact page. The company describes non-invasive respiratory monitoring and therapeutic products, with research, development and manufacturing performed in-house. Only the manufacturing function is expressly allocated to Therwil on the location list; the broader corporate R&D statement is not a quantified or building-specific Therwil laboratory claim. The about page displays a 17 June 2025 content timestamp and the contact page a 26 August 2026 timestamp; both were observed on 4 November 2026. A page update is not a relocation or expansion event. [RA01] [RA11]

Sentec's worldwide workforce statement is not used as Therwil employment. Occupied floor area, building tenure, lease expiry, rent, local headcount, cleanroom classes, manufacturing line capacity and available accommodation are not disclosed by these pages.

## Campus and building schedule

**TechCenter Reinach** is a mixed-use property proposition with laboratory, office, commercial and storage accommodation. Its own site publishes **TechCenter Reinach AG, Duggingerstrasse 15, CH-4153 Reinach BL**. That is the campus/operator postal reference, not the occupied address of every tenant. The current property description reports **over 25,000 m² of usable space across six floors**. The basis is source-stated usable space, not gross floor area, land area, lab-only inventory or available area; publication date is unknown and observation date is 4 November 2026. No occupied percentage or tenant allocation has been calculated. [RA02] [RA12]

The property site says it was designed and built in **2010**. A project-engineer record describes the historical D/E/F extension: two outer multifunctional buildings with a multi-storey car park between them, and subsequent tenant-specific works including Swiss BioQuant and Intertek. The engineer names TechCenter Reinach AG as the client. It provides no publication date, definitive completion date or separate historic floor-area total. Therefore the extension is historical configuration evidence, not an undated construction pipeline. No historic area is manufactured from construction cost or an aerial footprint. The supplied JLL extracts reviewed do not provide a historical Reinach/Aesch/Therwil property-area benchmark. [RA02] [RA13]

TechCenter's website identifies **Küng Real Estate** as the letting contact. TechCenter Reinach AG is the published property entity and website publisher, but the pages do not independently establish current cadastral ownership or ultimate beneficial ownership. Obtain the land-register extract and letting authority before treating either the publisher or the agent as the landlord. [RA02] [RA12]

**iCITY Reinach** publishes **Neuhofstrasse 11, 4153 Reinach**. Its legal notice identifies **Vebego AG** as the registered company behind iCITY, with a Zurich legal contact; Vebego's Zurich contact is not a BL laboratory site. Its offerings include furnished chemistry laboratories, biology and analytics labs fitted by agreement, custom-equipped labs and whole-floor lab/office combinations. The source expressly distinguishes ready-to-use rooms from shell-and-core/custom fit-out. [RA07] [RA14] [RA17]

iCITY's lab-floor page reports **3.5 m ceiling height** and **400–500 kg/m² floor-load capacity** for the offered lab-floor product. These are operator-advertised specification claims observed on 4 November 2026, with publication date unknown. They are not independently certified capabilities of every room. The private-lab page describes BSL1/BSL2 biology accommodation and optional safety cabinets. Unit-specific permit status, certified load diagrams, clear versus structural height, ventilation rates and utility redundancy still require technical verification. Do not treat images or image-alt descriptions as separate area or capability measurements. [RA17] [RA18]

clusters.detailedNarrative:
# Liestal–Sissach, Basel-Landschaft — canton detail V1

Liestal has a documented pharmaceutical manufacturing site, a specialty-pharmaceutical company address, an instrument-development headquarters and a hospital clinical-research anchor. This is a dispersed occupier corridor, not a verified multi-tenant laboratory campus. The clearest industrial footprint action is CordenPharma’s renovation of its existing Liestal facility. No source-backed biotechnology, pharmaceutical-manufacturing or laboratory campus in **Sissach itself** was established in the bounded sources reviewed. That is an evidence gap, not a finding that no such businesses exist. [LS01] [LS02] [LS03] [LS05] [LS07] [LS09]

Research cutoff and observation date: 4 November 2026. Liestal and Sissach are in canton BL; Lausen and Itingen are retained as intervening corridor municipalities, without attributed life-science sites. The canton’s municipality list also distinguishes Böckten from Sissach. Bubendorf, Muttenz–Pratteln, the Aargau/Fricktal extension and foreign sites are not merged into this record. [LS15]

## Occupier inventory

### Corden Pharma Switzerland LLC — Eichenweg 1, 4410 Liestal

CordenPharma’s live facility directory explicitly identifies **Corden Pharma Switzerland LLC** at Eichenweg 1. It assigns the site API research and development, GMP manufacturing, commercialization and API support, with peptide, lipid and small-molecule platforms. This is a physical operating facility, not the group headquarters address in Basel. [LS01]

The currently linked Liestal facility sheet describes advanced pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs, including small molecules, lipids, GalNAc and carbohydrates. It identifies on-site process and analytical development, quality control, a cGMP kilo laboratory and multipurpose manufacturing. It also describes a solid-state and purification centre of excellence, chromatographic work, lyophilization, hydrogenation and peptide-synthesis techniques. These are **operator-reported process capabilities**, not a building survey or independently checked current licence schedule. [LS02]

The sheet reports reactors of **20–2,500 L** and **27,000 L total reactor capacity**, scoped to Liestal’s stated equipment inventory. These are vessel-volume figures, not annual production output or floor area. The sheet’s publication date is unknown; its filename contains a 23 December 2025 revision indicator and it was linked by the live company directory when observed on 4 November 2026. No current gross building, net laboratory, occupied, leased or available floor area was established. No figure is imputed from manufacturing capability. [LS01] [LS02]

CordenPharma’s 24 October 2025 article says Liestal was “wrapping up” a five-year facility renovation to expand purification and small-scale development capacity. It does not establish a subsequent completion date, added floor area, a new numbered building or additional leased accommodation. Treat the action as a source-dated upgrade of an existing site, with completion and commissioning still to verify. [LS03]

The V6 snapshot has CordenPharma **Colorado**, `gco_70cd08d154f30063bd4f`, and a separate Colorado laboratory observation, `claude_csv:5c6eedfb4fa8:583`. Neither is the Swiss operator. The Liestal operator therefore remains an additional verified-address lead with null company/site master IDs. CordenPharma’s 5 March 2025 release reports Astorg’s ownership of the group following its earlier acquisition; that is corporate-ownership context, not proof of Liestal property ownership or any closure. The property owner, landlord and owned-versus-leased interest are unknown. [LS04]

### Curatis AG / Curatis Holding AG — Weierweg 7, 4410 Liestal

The company’s current site gives this address jointly for Curatis Holding AG and Curatis AG. It describes distribution, licensing and promotion of rare-disease and specialty-care medicines, alongside clinical development of its own drug candidates. Retain both disclosed entities at one shared company contact address; do not create two occupied suites or allocate floor space between them. No matching Curatis or Kinarus profile was found in V6, so these remain null-ID address-inventory leads. [LS05] [LS06]

The 21 September 2026 company release confirms continued development and commercial activity. Its manufacturing update says Curatis received API batches and was progressing drug-product technical development. It does **not** identify Liestal as the batch-production plant or a wet-lab location. The Weierweg record supports a pharmaceutical business address, not an on-site GMP plant, warehouse, cleanroom or clinical-study centre. No 2025/2026 office move, lease, expansion or giveback is established by the sources used. [LS16]

Occupied area, landlord, tenure, local employees, rent, expiry, fit-out and availability remain unknown. The exact subsidiary ownership chain should be checked in the current filing before being used for lease-credit attribution; the joint website label alone is not a lease guarantee. [LS05] [LS06]

### Nanosurf AG — Gräubernstrasse 12–14, 4410 Liestal

Nanosurf’s official company page identifies this address and its role in developing atomic-force-microscopy instruments for academic research and industrial applications, including life science and materials science. Its location and historical expansion page identify Liestal as the headquarters. This is a scientific-instruments occupier, not a therapeutics developer or a demonstrated GMP medicines plant. The official page states that Nanosurf is part of Lab14 Group; it does not disclose who owns the Liestal real estate. No Nanosurf company/site ID was found in V6. [LS07] [LS08]

The street range must remain intact. The official address register resolves numbers 12 and 14 independently, but neither the company page nor the register allocates functions, tenancy or area between them. The suffix address 12b returned by a broad geocoder query is not assigned to Nanosurf. No Liestal floor area, lease terms, landlord or current availability is established. [LS07] [LS20] [LS21]
